name: Giraffe
summary: Tall and dappled, neck straight up.
text:
Tall and narrow, each patch painted one at a time, the neck rising straight. It stands on a dark wooden base.

A piece that grows with the child — it works as a room ornament even when it is off.

options.name: Power
options.help: Batteries are not included. The mains version comes with a remote: on, off, dimmer, timer and a slow pulse.

options.name: Laser engraving
options.help: A name, a date or a short phrase, burned into the wood. Leave it empty if you would rather not.
